description: Find the ingredient cost of a batch and each sellable portion from package prices and quantities used. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version and a source-page URL. No prices or omitted costs are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

batchCost.description: Known ingredient cost for this complete batch. Invoices, recipe quantity and measured batch yield. Owner records or explicit assumption; no account connection or maintained rate tables required. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.
